arms.original: question plus the matching real image
arms.blank_same_geometry: same question plus a neutral image with identical pixel dimensions
arms.mismatched_same_domain: same question plus the next real image from the same source domain
arms.text_only: same question with no image; sequence geometry is not controlled

privacy.stored_values: aggregate sufficient statistics and aggregate behavioural scores only

limitations: This is a small paired diagnostic, not a leaderboard-quality benchmark.
Blank-image controls preserve source pixel dimensions; mismatched images need not preserve them.
Text-only changes multimodal sequence geometry and is therefore a secondary control.
Reference-containment and token F1 are lightweight automatic metrics, not semantic judging.
All measurements describe the deployed NVFP4 checkpoint; no BF16 baseline exists.
